sampling.algorithm: accepted shifted-Halton without canonical boundary points
sampling.selection_after_geometry_preflight: first 96 valid raw rows for development/calibration; from remaining valid rows select six lowest raw-index interpolation, five minimum coordinate-to-boundary distance, then five maximum nearest-candidate distance with design-id tie breaks

geometry_preflight.attempt_policy: construct requested divergent exit radius first; after a continuity-only rejection call the actual production constructor at each nextafter(radius, chamber_radius) value

fidelities.pairing: geometry SHA-256 and signed ampere-turn sequence
fidelities.interpolation: exact nested-grid bilinear prolongation; coincident nodes copied exactly

outputs.field: concatenated Br,Bz on fixed high-fidelity mesh

candidate_models.selection: smallest budget passing all development gates; then minimum worst scalar NRMSE, field L2, lexical family

gates.decision_safety: no point is surrogate-acceptable when OOD or topology uncertainty/mismatch is flagged

latency.comparison: coarse solve plus scalar/field inference and safety checks versus high solve

provenance.before_first_field_solve: sidecar-protected protocol, partitions, geometry preflight, environment and full Git blob closure
provenance.strict_loader: validates either terminal success or terminal failure bundle

integrity.protocol_commit_subject: preregister L1a field surrogate v2 experiment
integrity.results_commit_subject: record L1a field surrogate v2 results
integrity.full_git_blob_closure: all HEAD blobs under v2 experiment/tests and imported accepted roots

claim_limits: The high-fidelity target is the accepted L1a numerical discretization, not physical truth.
No material, plasma, thermal, structural, propulsion or hardware accuracy is claimed.
V1 is immutable disclosed development evidence only and contributes no v2 labels.
